z-m-11-01.title: Wadartu waa ka weyn tahay tirada ardayda. Shaxdu ma khaldan tahay?
z-m-11-01.topic: Wadarooyinka shaxda iyo tirada dadka la sahamiyey (xog halka hal qof uu mar ka badan calaamadeeyey)
z-m-11-01.goal: Marka wadarta shaxda ay ka duwan tahay tirada ardayda la sahamiyey, ha gunaanan shaxdu inay khaldan tahay, laakiin sheeg waxa kale oo aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato sida habka sahanka, oo hagaaji xukunkaaga macluumaad cusub.
z-m-11-01.material:
Fasalka 3 ee Fasalka 4 wuxuu leeyahay 28 arday. Waxay sahamiyeen 'goobta ay rabaan inay aadaan socdaal' oo waxay sameeyeen shaxda hoose. Tirooyinka shaxda waa tirada ardayda ○ ku dhigtay goobtaas.

| Goob | Madxaf | Beerta xayawaanka | Xarunta sayniska | Beerta madadaalada | Wadar |
| Arday (tirada dadka) | 12 | 10 | 9 | 7 | 38 |

Jia ayaa yidhi, "Wadartu waa 38 laakiin fasalkayagu wuxuu leeyahay 28 arday. Shaxdu waa khalad!" (Shaxda waxaa lagu qoray erayo, sidaas darteed sawir ma jiro. Safafka shaxdu, kor ilaa hoos, waa goob iyo tirada ardayda.)
z-m-11-01.thinking.0: Kala saaridda waxa shaxdu keligeed sheegi karto iyo waxa aysan sheegi karin
z-m-11-01.thinking.1: Iskaa u sheegidda macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee loo baahan yahay
z-m-11-01.thinking.2: Hagaajinta xukunkaaga iyo kalsoonidaada mar kasta oo macluumaad cusub soo baxo
z-m-11-01.prereq.0: Akhrinta tirada shay kasta oo shax ku jira iyo isku darka (heerka Fasallada 3-4)
z-m-11-01.prereq.1: In sahanka dhexdiisa ay jiraan kiisas 'hal qof doorto hal shay oo keliya' iyo kiisas 'hal qof doorto dhowr shay'
z-m-11-01.s.s1.prompt: Xog dheeraad ah ayaa la muujiyaa hal hal. Mar kasta dooro fikradaada.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.0: Garab garab u qor wadarta iyo tirada ardayda oo marka hore eeg intee ay ku kala duwan yihiin.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.1: Adigoo isticmaalaya tusaale yar (3 arday), tiri imisa calaamad ayaa ka badan ardayda marka hal qof uu calaamadeeyo laba goobood.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Waxa hadda la yaqaan waa shaxda iyo tirada ardayda (28) oo keliya. Warqadda sahanka weli lama arkin.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma u malaynaysaa shaxdani inay khaldan tahay?
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Wadarta 38 waxay noqon kartaa sababtoo ah habka sahanka, ama sababtoo ah isla arday ayaa laba jeer la tiriyey marka la tirinayo. Waxaad ogaan kartaa kaliya adigoo eegaya warqadda sahanka.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Wadartu waxay ka duwan tahay tirada ardayda, sidaas darteed shaxda si khaldan ayaa loo tiriyey
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Waxaad eedaysay habka tirinta sababtoo ah wadartu waxay ka duwan tahay tirada ardayda. Marka hore ka fikir haddii tani ay dhici karto iyadoo ku xiran habka sahanka.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ilaa aan aragno warqadda sahanka, ma ogaan karno haddii shaxdu khaldan tahay
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Waxaad ku joogsatay meesha saxda ah. Kani waa fikir xasuusatay in isla shax, wadartu ay kala duwanaan karto iyadoo ku xiran habka sahanka.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Haddii wadartu ka weyn tahay tirada ardayda, shaxdu had iyo jeer waa sax
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lid ku ah, aad bay u dhaqso u rumaysay. Sababta wadartu u weyn tahay waxay noqon kartaa khalad tirin, sidaas darteed waa inaad hubisaa.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Warqadda sahanku waxay tidhi, "○ ku dhig goobaha aad rabto inaad aadto. Waxaad dooran kartaa ilaa laba." Macallinkii marka hore kala saaray warqadaha wuxuu yidhi dhammaan 28-ka arday waxay ○ ku dhigeen ugu yaraan hal goob.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Imisa arday ayaa ○ ku dhigay laba goobood?
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Sida macallinku yidhi, haddii qof kastaa calaamadeeyey ugu yaraan hal goob oo ugu badnaan laba, 38-ka calaamadood waxay la mid yihiin 28-ka arday oo lagu daray tirada ardayda doortay laba goobood. Sidaas darteed 10 arday ayaa doortay laba goobood.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waad fiicantahay inaad heshay in qaddarka aad hesho marka tirada ardayda, 28, laga jaro tirada calaamadaha ○, 38, uu yahay tirada calaamadaha la sameeyey 'hal mar oo dheeraad ah'.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Waxay u egtahay inaad ka fikirtay badhka 28. Ka fikir micnaha farqiga u dhexeeya 38-ka calaamadood iyo 28-ka arday.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxay u egtahay inaad ka fikirtay badhka 38. Tiri imisa calaamad ayaa ka badan ardayda haddii hal qof doorto laba goobood.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Marka macallinku mar kale hubiyey warqadaha sahanka laga bilaabo bilowga, bayaankii hore wuu khaldanaa. 4 arday midna goob ma calaamadeynin, 24-ka kale-na waxay calaamadeeyeen hal ama laba goobood.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hadda, imisa arday ayaa ○ ku dhigay laba goobood?
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 24-ka arday dhexdooda, haddii 10 doorteen hal goob oo keliya 14-na doorteen laba goobood, tirada calaamadaha waa 10+28=38. Marka macluumaad cusub soo galo, jawaabtu way is beddelaa xitaa isla shax.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Waxaad isku qasay tirada ardayda goob aan calaamadeynin iyo tirada ardayda laba goobood calaamadeeyey. Kuwani waa dad kala duwan.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Waxaad jawaabtii tallaabadii hore u gudbisay sidiisa. Mar kale hubi haddii 4-ta arday ee aad hadda bartay ay u baahan yihiin inay galaan xisaabta.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kani waa fikir mar kale xalliyey macluumaadka cusub. Waxaad heshay kiiska 24-ka arday ay doortaan hal ama laba goobood tirada calaamaduhuna noqoto 38.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga, fikirkaagu ma ku dhawaa 'shaxdu waa khalad' mise 'ma garan karno'? Maxay warqadda sahanka iyo macluumaadka ku saabsan 4-ta arday ee aan jawaabin mid kasta beddeleen? Haddii weli wax aadan ogayn, waa maxay?
z-m-11-01.s.s2.prompt: Waad ogtahay in warqadda sahanku tidhi 'ilaa laba goobood'. Dooro dhammaan waxyaabaha aad si badbaado leh u odhan kartid adigoo isticmaalaya tirooyinka shaxdan iyo waxa warqadda sahanka ku jira oo keliya.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qiyaas hal arday oo ○ ku dhigay laba goobood, madxafka iyo beerta xayawaanka. Sanduuqyo kee ayuu ardaygaasi galaa?
z-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.1: Bayaan kasta, eeg haddii 'isla arday uu laba jeer la tirin karo'.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.a: Ardayda doortay madxafka ama beerta xayawaanka wadarkoodu waa 22
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.a: 12+10=22 waxay noqon kartaa qiime tiriyey arday doortay labada goobood laba jeer. Waad odhan kartaa waa 22 arday 'ama ka yar', laakiin ma odhan kartid hubaal inay tahay 22.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.b: Hal sanduuq oo shaxda ka mid ah waa tirada ardayda ○ ku dhigtay goobtaas, sidaas darteed sidan ayaad u akhriyi kartaa.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.c: 38, wadarta afarta tiro ee shaxda, waa tirada ardayda ○ ku dhigtay
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.c: 38 waa tirada jeerarka ○ la calaamadeeyey. Hal arday ayaa laga yaabaa inuu laba jeer calaamadeeyey, sidaas darteed waa inaadan u akhriyin sida tirada ardayda.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.d: 12-ka arday ee doortay madxafka iyo 10-ka arday ee doortay beerta xayawaanka waa arday kala duwan
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.d: Waxaad dooran kartay laba goobood, sidaas darteed isla arday wuxuu ku jiri karaa labada kooxood.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.e: Ardayda doortay xarunta sayniska waa 2 ka badan ardayda doortay beerta madadaalada
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.e: Sanduuq kasta waa tirada ardayda doortay goobtaas, sidaas darteed bayaan isbarbar dhigaya laba sanduuq waa badbaado.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.explain: Tirada sanduuq kastaa waa tirada ardayda doortay goobtaas, sidaas darteed bayaan akhrinaya hal sanduuq ama isbarbar dhigaya laba sanduuq waa badbaado. Qiime isku daraya sanduuqyada ayaa laga yaabaa inuu isla arday dhowr jeer tiriyey, sidaas darteed ma akhriyi kartid sida 'tirada ardayda'.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.prompt: Jia ayaa yidhi, "Wadartu way ka weyn tahay tirada ardayda, sidaas darteed shaxdu waa khalad!" Maxaad u sheegi lahayd Jia? Sidoo kale qor waxa kale oo aad u baahan tahay inaad ogaato si aad u go'aamiso haddii shaxdu khaldan tahay.

z-m-11-01.s.s3.hint.1: Qor ugu yaraan hal sabab oo suurtagal ah oo wadartu ka weyn tahay, oo kuwa mid kasta ula mid dhig waxa aad u baahan tahay inaad eegto si aad u hubiso.

z-m-11-02.title: Habka Minseo u akhriyo garaafka sawirrada: maxaa u muuqda yaab leh?
z-m-11-02.topic: Waxa sawirka weyn iyo sawirka yar ay metelaan garaafka sawirrada
z-m-11-02.goal: Ku muuji tusaale lid ku ah in garaafka sawirrada halka sawirro cabbirro kala duwan ay leeyihiin qiimayaal kala duwan, isbarbar dhigidda tirinta sawirrada oo keliya ay khaldami karto, oo sheeg shuruudaha isbarbar dhigidda tirinta ay fiicantahay.
z-m-11-02.material:
Tirada rootiga la iibiyey maalin gudaheed afar rooti-sameeyayaal xaafad ah waxaa lagu muujiyey garaaf sawirro ah. Hal sawir weyn oo rooti ah wuxuu metelayaa 10 rooti, hal sawir yar oo rooti ahna wuxuu metelayaa 1 rooti. Sawir ma jiro, sidaas darteed waxaa lagu qoray erayo.

| Rooti-sameeye | Sawirrada rootiga ee waaweyn | Sawirrada rootiga ee yaryar |
| 가 | 3 | 4 |
| 나 | 2 | 9 |
| 다 | 4 | 0 |
| 라 | 3 | 7 |

Minseo ayaa akhriyey garaafkan oo ku soo koobay lixda khad ee hoose.

z-m-11-02.thinking.2: Sheegidda shuruudaha ay run ku tahay

z-m-11-02.s.s1.hint.0: Si aad u hubiso waxa khadka 6 sheegayo, hel tirada rootiga la iibiyey ee rooti-sameeyaha leh sawirrada ugu badan iyo rooti-sameeyaha leh sawirrada ugu yar, oo garab garab dhig.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tirooyinka la iibiyey ee aad ka heshay khadadka 2 ilaa 4 mar kale u nidaamee cabbirka, oo la barbar dhig gunaanadka khadka 6.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.0: 1. Hal sawir weyn oo rooti ah wuxuu metelayaa 10 rooti, hal sawir yar oo rooti ahna wuxuu metelayaa 1 rooti.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.1: 2. Rooti-sameeyaha 가 wuxuu leeyahay 3 sawir oo waaweyn iyo 4 sawir oo yaryar, sidaas darteed wuxuu iibiyey 30+4=34 rooti.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.2: 3. Rooti-sameeyaha 나 wuxuu leeyahay 2 sawir oo waaweyn iyo 9 sawir oo yaryar, sidaas darteed wuxuu iibiyey 20+9=29 rooti.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.3: 4. Rooti-sameeyaha 다 wuxuu leeyahay 4 sawir oo waaweyn oo keliya, sidaas darteed wuxuu iibiyey 40 rooti. Rooti-sameeyaha 라 wuxuu leeyahay 3 sawir oo waaweyn iyo 7 sawir oo yaryar, sidaas darteed wuxuu iibiyey 37 rooti.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.4: 5. Tirada sawirrada afarta rooti-sameeye waa 가 7, 나 11, 다 4, 라 10.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.line.5: 6. Rooti-sameeyaha leh sawirrada ugu badan waa Rooti-sameeyaha 나 (11), sidaas darteed Rooti-sameeyaha 나 wuxuu iibiyey rooti ugu badan.
z-m-11-02.s.s1.explain: Khadka 6 waa yaab. Garaafkan, sawirro cabbirro kala duwan waxay metelaan tirooyin kala duwan, sidaas darteed sawirro badan micnaheedu maaha iibin badan. Rooti-sameeyaha 나 wuxuu leeyahay 11 sawir laakiin wuxuu iibiyey 29, Rooti-sameeyaha 다-na wuxuu leeyahay 4 sawir oo keliya laakiin, maadaama ay yihiin sawirro waaweyn, wuxuu iibiyey 40, kan ugu badan.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.prompt: Garaafkan, isbarbar dhigidda tirinta tirada sawirrada way khaldami kartaa. Dooro dhammaan kiisaska aad ku odhan karto dhinaca kee ayaa leh wax ka badan adigoo eegaya tirada sawirrada oo keliya.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qaado Rooti-sameeyaha 가 (weyn 3, yar 4) iyo Rooti-sameeyaha 나 (weyn 2, yar 9), oo si gooni ah u isbarbar dhig tirada sawirrada waaweyn iyo tirada sawirrada yaryar.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.hint.1: Doorasho kasta, samee hal tusaale oo tijaabi haddii dhinaca leh sawirro badan waajib ahaan uu iibiyey wax badan.
z-m-11-02.s.s2.o.a: Kiis halka labada rooti-sameeye ay isticmaalaan sawirro rooti oo waaweyn oo keliya
z-m-11-02.s.s2.r.a: Haddii ay jirto hal cabbir oo sawir ah, hal sawir wuxuu metelaa isla tiro, sidaas darteed isbarbar dhigidda tirada sawirrada oo keliya waa fiican tahay.

z-m-11-02.s.s2.o.c: Kiis halka hal rooti-sameeye uu leeyahay sawirro waaweyn oo badan iyo sawirro yaryar oo badan marka loo eego midka kale

z-m-11-07.title: Dib u samaynta doorashooyinka sahanka buugaagta si aanay is-dul-saarin
z-m-11-07.topic: Samaynta shayada sahanka (doorashooyin): is-dul-saar la'aan iyo wax laga reebin la'aan
z-m-11-07.goal: Ka fikir sida loo akhriyo natiijooyinka marka doorashooyinka sahanku is-dul-saaran yihiin ama wax ka tagaan, oo naftaada u samee doorashooyin aan is-dul-saarin oo qof walba kuu ogolaanaya inuu doorto hal.
z-m-11-07.material:
Fasalka 3aad ee Fasalka 4aad wuxuu sahamiyay 'nooca buugga ay rabaan inay akhriyaan' si buugaag cusub loogu iibsado maktabadda fasalka. Qof walba wuxuu doortay hal oo keliya, dhammaan 27-ka arday-na waa jawaabeen. Doorashooyinka sahanka iyo natiijooyinka waa sidan.

| Doorasho | Buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta | Buugaagta majaajillada | Taariikh nololeedyada | Buugaagta sheekada | Buugaagta sayniska |
| Arday (tirada dadka) | 8 | 9 | 3 | 5 | 2 |

(Sahanku wuxuu yidhi buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta waa buugaag leh sheekooyin male-awaal ah, buugaagta sheekadana waa buugaag leh sheeko qaab-dhismeed leh. Buugaagta taariikhda iyo buugaagta gabayada kuma jirin doorashooyinka.)
z-m-11-07.thinking.1: Xisaabinta sida is-dul-saarku u saameeyo akhrinta natiijooyinka
z-m-11-07.thinking.2: Naftaada u samaynta doorashooyin iyo bixinta sababta
z-m-11-07.prereq.0: Akhrinta natiijooyinka sahanka ee shax loo habeeyay
z-m-11-07.prereq.1: Ogaanshaha farqiga u dhexeeya 'doorashada hal oo keliya' iyo 'doorashada dhowr'
z-m-11-07.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan dhibaatooyinka ka timaadi kara doorashooyinka sahankan.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir hal buug oo ku habboon labadaba buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta iyo buugaagta sheekada. Kee ayaad u malaynaysaa inuu arday dooran lahaa?
z-m-11-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir dhowr nooc oo buugaag ah oo dadku rabaan inay akhriyaan, oo eeg haddii qaar aysan ku habboonayn meel kasta doorashooyinka.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.a: Waxaa jira 5 doorasho, sidaas darteed way adag tahay ardayda inay doortaan hal oo keliya
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.a: 5 ma badna. Dhibaatadu ma aha tirada laakiin waa xidhiidhka u dhexeeya doorashooyinka.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.b: Buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta iyo buugaagta sheekada way is-dul-saaran yihiin, sidaas darteed sanduuqa ay ardaydu doortaan wuu ku kala duwanaan karaa arday ilaa arday
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.b: Waxaad heshay inay labada doorasho isku eg yihiin, sidaas darteed dadku laga yaabaa inay si kala duwan u doortaan isla buug.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.c: Buugaagta majaajillada waxay ku jiraan doorashooyinka, sidaas darteed sahanku wuu khaldamayaa
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.c: Buug oo ku jira doorashooyinka ma ka dhigo sahanka mid khaldan. Ka fikir haddii doorashooyinku is-dul-saaran yihiin ama wax ka tagaan.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.d: Arday rabaa inuu akhriyo buugaagta taariikhda ama buugaagta gabayada ma leh doorasho uu dooran karo
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad heshay inay jiraan arday rabaan nooc aan sahanka ku jirin. Waa jawaabeen, laakiin laga yaabaa inaanay awoodin inay geliyaan fikirkooda.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.explain: Haddii doorashooyinku is-dul-saaran yihiin, ardayda leh isla fikir waxay galaan sanduuqyo kala duwan, haddii noocyo maqan yihiinna, ardaydaasi waa inay isku qasbaan inay doortaan sanduuqa ugu dhow. Tiro badan oo doorashooyin ah ama nooc gaar ah oo la geliyay ma aha dhibaato.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.prompt: Junho wuxuu hadlay sida hoose kadib arkidda natiijooyinka sahanka. Sadarkee ayaa yaab ah? (Lambarrada sadarrada waxay ka bilaabmaan 1.)
z-m-11-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir haddii, 5-ta arday ee doortay buugaagta sheekada dhexdooda, ay jiri karaan arday sidoo kale jecel buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sadar kasta, hubi 'haddii isla ardayga laba jeer la gelin karo marka sanduuqyada la isku daro ama la barbar dhigo'.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.0: 1. Qof walba wuxuu doortay hal oo keliya, sidaas darteed 27, wadarta dhammaan tirooyinka shaxda, waa tirada ardayda jawaabay.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.1: 2. Buugaagta majaajillada, leh 9 arday, waa sanduuqa ugu badan la doortay.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.2: 3. 3 ee taariikh nololeedyada iyo 2 ee buugaagta sayniska waa arday kala duwan, sidaas darteed wadajir waa 5.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.3: 4. 8 arday ayaa doortay buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta, sidaas darteed 8 arday oo keliya ayaa jecel buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.4: 5. Ardayda doortay buugaagta majaajillada waa 1 ka badan ardayda doortay buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.explain: Sadarka 4 waa yaab. 5-ta arday ee doortay buugaagta sheekada dhexdooda, waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan arday sidoo kale jecel buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta, sidaas darteed wax ka badan 8 arday ayaa laga yaabaa inay jecel yihiin buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta. Maadaama qof walba doortay hal oo keliya, waad isku dari kartaa sanduuqyada sida sadarrada 1 iyo 3.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.prompt: Dib u samee doorashooyinka sahanka. Qor 5 ama ka yar, ka dhig kuwo aan is-dul-saarin si qof walba u doorto hal oo keliya, oo hubi inay jirto meel arday kasta uu ku dooran karo. Kadibna hal ama laba weedh ku qor sababta aad sidaas ugu kala qaybisay.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.hint.0: Marka hore go'aami hal halbeeg oo lagu kala qaybiyo buugaagta (tusaale ahaan, nuxurka ama qaabka), oo qor doorashooyinka halbeeggaas.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka fikir saddex cinwaan oo buug ah oo hal-hal tijaabi haddii mid kastaa uu galo sax ahaan hal doorasho.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma tijaabisay tusaalayaal haddii ay jirto buug ku habboon laba doorasho ama ka badan isla mar?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma jirtaa meel arday rabaa inuu akhriyo buugaagta taariikhda ama buugaagta gabayada uu ku dooran karo?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Haddii aad ku dartay sanduuq sida 'buugaag kale', ma ka fikirtay inuu sanduuqaas noqon karo mid aad u weyn?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.model.0: Doorashooyinka: buugaagta sheekada (oo ay ku jiraan buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta), buugaagta majaajillada, buugaagta sayniska, taariikhda iyo taariikh nololeedyada, buugaag kale. Buugaagta sheekooyinka caruurta iyo buugaagta sheekada way is-dul-saaran yihiin, sidaas darteed waxaan ka dhigay hal, waxaanan ku daray 'buugaag kale' si ardayda rabta inay akhriyaan buugaag aan meel ku habboonayn ay u dooran karaan.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.model.1: Doorashooyinka: sheekooyinka, buugaagta majaajillada, buugaagta aqoonta (sayniska iyo taariikhda), buugaagta gabayada, taariikh nololeedyada. Waxaan u kala qaybiyay nuxurka buugaagta si buug aanu u kala jabin laba sanduuq. Maadaama sanduuqyo is-dul-saaran aysan jirin, waxaan u malaynayaa ardaydu inay ku dhammaan doonaan inay doortaan isla sanduuq.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Waxay u kala qaybisay halbeeg nuxur oo hubisay inaysan is-dul-saarin, laakiin ma hadlin 'ka-reebid'.
